d:
A large avian species with a bulky build, featuring deep crimson plumage across the body and a thick, powerful beak. The head is adorned with a crown of long, electric yellow feathers and sharp, focused golden eyes. The wings are expansive with crimson feathers and the tail is a short, tufted crimson plume. Three thick claws per foot and three sharp talons per wing-hand.
BODY COLOR: deep crimson
